notes: Transcribed from sue604-evaluation.md §2.4, "the one net regression". Two real, unrepaired findings remain: native_fluency FAIL (stiffer 유지되었지만 + redundant restatement, routes_to native_fluency per LANGUAGE_DIMENSION_ROUTES) and audience_fit FAIL (deleted concrete agent 돈을 빌려주는 사람들, routes_to audience). These sit at different feedback-routing layers; this record's outcome/routes_to (PROSE_REWORK/native_fluency) reflects the layer carrying two of the three regressions the evaluation names, while the audience_fit dimension finding still carries its own correct dimension-level routes_to of 'audience' independently. SUE-604 POST-EVALUATION REPAIR: at the time of the independent evaluation, this draft's genre_fit paragraph asserted a verbatim-looking quotation the canonical source never made -- the evaluation's own text records AFTER as originally reading "...이런 흐름을 두고 \"채권시장 위기라기보다 글로벌 term premium의 재가격\"이라며, ...근거로 들었다" -- wrapping a constructed paraphrase in quotation marks with a closing speech verb (이라며 ... 근거로 들었다), when the canonical view's actual words are "'채권시장 붕괴'보다 ... 재가격". The evaluation flagged this as F4 (routes to 'normative': a gap in the pack about whether quotation marks may enclose a paraphrase) and separately as a genre_fit caveat, but did not FAIL genre_fit or semantic_integrity for it because the underlying claim was faithful even though the wording quoted was not the source's own. This has since been repaired in the draft to the source's actual wording ("'채권시장 붕괴'보다 ... 재가격" -- see genre_fit evidence_span above, current draft state). No automated gate caught the original mismatch; the independent evaluation did, via direct comparison against the canonical view's text. Recorded here as history, not as a live finding: genre_fit is PASS in this record because it reflects the repaired draft. Comparative dimensions abstain: not assessed by the source evaluation. comparison.mode is "abstain" and outcome is ABSTAIN where no language dimension failed: the evaluation this record transcribes assessed only the seven absolute language_quality dimensions and made no comparative judgement against a reference on any of the five comparative axes. Recording mode "pairwise" would assert a comparison that never happened, and a comparative PASS would claim the draft was measured against the reference and held up. The references are still named because they were the genre-matched pool available and a later comparative pass should use them.
